spanish: Su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: sólet leaves the common noun סֹלֶת untranslated instead of Spanish
amasada narrows the qal passive of בלל (mixed) to kneading
minjá leaves the common noun מִנְחָה untranslated instead of Spanish

notes: Counts, suffixes, silver, shekel, and holiness otherwise track the tokens.
